THE GAP BETWEEN A SCAN AND A SALE

A good conversation
deserves more than
“great to meet you.”

You have a booth to run, visitors to speak to, and a team to coordinate. The follow-up list gets longer as the show goes on.

Vyuha adds a focused operating layer around your show: research before it, context during it, and follow-through after it. Every approach has a reason. Every open thread has an owner.

BEFORE WE START

A few practical
questions.

Is this a fit for our team?

It is built for B2B exhibitors with a paid booth at a named trade show, a clear buyer profile, and someone available to approve outreach. We check the timing and scope together before committing.

What do you need from us?

Your show and booth details, buyer goals, one approval contact, claims to avoid, and a way to share visitor notes or lead exports. A short kickoff locks the scope.

What if our show is very soon?

Tell us the dates. We will agree what is feasible for the time left. A late start changes the pre-show workload; it does not justify promising meetings we cannot guarantee.

How much does it cost?

We confirm scope and pricing after reviewing your show, timing, and needs. There is no payment required to discuss fit.
